title: BEACON D5 rumor / misinformation board (FR-D4-1, FEV-20)
description: The wire shape of the read-only rumor board projected from a completed deterministic news-grounding pass (src/application/coordination/rumor-board.ts). It carries ALREADY-FLAGGED signals with their flag reason and corroboration state; it never adjudicates truth and never merges a flagged item into a fact. Two invariants are encoded as CONSTS rather than described in prose: every row's `flagged` is `true` and every row's `corroboratingSourceCount` is `0`, so a corroborated fact is not a valid row of this document. Aggregate-only (Art. XIV): a row identifies an OUTLET and a claim, never a person — the schema walk in the D5 aggregate-only test enforces that.

rows.description: Flagged signals, in the deterministic order the grounding pass minted them.

caveat.description: The caveat every rumor surface renders: listing is routing for human review, not a verdict.

field.description: The grounded-fact field id (e.g. `news-unverified-1`) — stable and deterministic.

claim.description: The deterministic claim sentence, which already carries the flag reason in words.

sourceId.description: SOURCE_RECORD id of the outlet that carried the signal (`news:<host>`) — an outlet, not a person.

citationId.description: Stable citation id for this grounding.

flagged.description: Always true. A non-flagged fact is not representable as a row (FEV-20's never-merge rule).

corroboratingSourceCount.description: Always 0. A flagged item contributes nothing to corroboration, by contract.

reason.description: Why the deterministic pass flagged it. Mirrors RUMOR_FLAG_REASONS (pinned by test).

disposition.description: Says out loud, on every row and at every render site, what happened to this item.

summary.description: Counts carried through BY IDENTITY from the grounding pass — never recomputed by the board.

corroboratedFactCount.description: Authoritative corroborated facts minted by the same pass — context, never blended with the flagged rows.

corroboration.description: [0,1] corroboration strength of the AUTHORITATIVE stream only.
